experiments.question: Does released CLM-v0.1-8B contain any usable zero-shot signal for the three target positions?
experiments.single_factor: Frozen Qwen3-8B plus released CLM heads over deterministic causal state text.

experiments.question: Can the released CLM projection heads learn a valid three-choice trading decision surface while Qwen3-8B stays frozen?
experiments.single_factor: Fine-tune only the released state/action projection heads with the per-question choice objective; the generic duplicate-action InfoNCE path is forbidden.

experiments.question: Does explicit agent-state observability improve the CLM probe and a matched R0 control?
experiments.single_factor: Add agent_state_v1 to CLM state serialization and to R0 with identical timing and normalization.

experiments.question: Can CLM-style matching select better offline tasks than rule or random curricula?
experiments.single_factor: Rank only validated TaskSpec candidates from causal market summaries and versioned capability gaps while freezing the solver architecture and total solver compute.

experiments.question: Can a future CLM-style MarketFramer rank validated CandidateTask objects plus WAIT safely?
experiments.single_factor: Replay-only CandidateTask ranking with a frozen deterministic capability-eligibility mask and frozen solver outputs.

experiments.question: Given frozen MarketFramer candidates, can a separate CapabilityMatcher select a valid solver profile or no match?
experiments.single_factor: Rank versioned held-out CapabilityProfile rows for fixed candidates while freezing candidate order, solver outputs, and capability snapshots.

experiments.question: If exact CLM has useful signal but fails resource gates, can its geometry be distilled into the numerical solver?
experiments.single_factor: Replace only R0 Linear(hidden,3) with a normalized state projection, three learned action prototypes, and a bounded learned temperature.
